levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The reply is overly casual or missing a clear acceptance statement.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The reply clearly accepts the offer in a professional tone.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reply also proactively addresses one logistical detail (like start date confirmation) without being asked.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than five questions are listed, or most duplicate information already in the fictional offer email.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least five specific, non-duplicate questions are listed.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The questions cover a range of categories (logistics, expectations, people) rather than clustering on one type.

lookFors: The reply contains an unambiguous acceptance statement.
At least five distinct first-day questions are listed, not repeats of the same idea reworded.
No real employer, real job posting, or real personal employment history is required.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
